Egypt
Consular assistance:Consular assistance is provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following BH travel documents:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Arab Republic of Egypt are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Citizens of the Arab Republic Egypt, holders of diplomatic, official and special passports are exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa to enter, exit , transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina, holders of diplomatic and service passports, are exempt from visa requirement to enter, exit, transit and stay on the territory of the Arab Republic of Egypt for a total period of no longer than 90 days.
